Adding two-row subset and ascending-triplet one-orientation three-row moves gives one directed reachable component and 9216 edges, 2304 nonreciprocal; degree classes 432x14 and 144x22.
result: Universal irreducibility for the restricted move families CONTRADICTED; asserted direct inverse availability in original PR #30 CONTRADICTED by PR #31. Combined directed connectivity VERIFIED but no reversible or uniform-sampling kernel established.
